cohort: 364 pregnancies complicated by placenta praevia managed at two tertiary hospitals in Istanbul between January 2005 and December 2010
finding: The rates of curettage history and caesarean delivery were significantly higher in the group with placenta accreta, and emergency surgery had negative effects on maternal outcomes in the placenta praevia group.
mod_finding: Women with a history of cesarean delivery had a significantly higher rate of placenta accreta in cases of placenta previa.
